{{Short description|Finnish online service}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=July 2025}}
'''Findicator''' ({{langx|fi|Findikaattori}}, {{langx|sv|Findikator}}) was an [[online service]] providing up-to-date [[Statistics|statistical]] information on the progress of [[Finland]] with about 100 [[Economic indicator|indicators]] describing various aspects of society.<ref name="Stat">[http://www.stat.fi/ajk/poimintoja/2012-03-07_findikaattori_en.html Statistics Finland - The Findicator service now also in Swedish and English]</ref> The service was trilingual: all material was available in English, Finnish and Swedish.<ref name="Stat"/> The graphs and tables of the service were automatically updated from a database as new information was published by governmental data producers.<ref name="fsd28">[http://www.fsd.uta.fi/lehti/en/28/lyhyet.html FSD Bulletin, Issue 28]</ref>

Findicator was developed in a joint effort by [[Statistics Finland]] and the [[Prime Minister of Finland|Finnish Prime Minister's Office]].<ref name="Stat"/> Its goal was to improve the availability and accessibility of indicator-type statistical data. Prime Ministers [[Matti Vanhanen]] and [[Jyrki Katainen]] endorsed the service.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://vnk.fi/ajankohtaista/tiedotteet/tiedote/fi.jsp?oid=352514 |title=Prime Minister's Office - Renewed Findicator to support decision making |access-date=2012-06-04 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130213091338/http://vnk.fi/ajankohtaista/tiedotteet/tiedote/fi.jsp?oid=352514 |archive-date=2013-02-13 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130213140329/http://vnk.fi/ajankohtaista/tiedotteet/tiedote/sv.jsp?oid=273329&c=0&toid=5299&moid=5301|title=Prime Minister's Office - Findicator provides up-to-date information on the progress of society in a user-friendly way}}</ref>

[[OECD]] Public Governance Review wrote that the Finnish government is exploring through the Findicator initiative how it can establish indicators for desired societal outcomes and relay these to the public administration and to society in general.<ref>{{cite book |last1=Organisation for Economic Co-Operation and Development|title=OECD Public Governance Reviews Finland: Working Together to Sustain Success
|year=2010|publisher=OECD Publishing|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=RZEqF1ZLRXkC&dq=findicator+oecd&pg=PA28|isbn=978-9264085893|page=28}}</ref> [[Clerk of the Privy Council (Canada)|Clerk of the Privy Council]] [[Jocelyne Bourgon]] stated that from an international perspective, Finland has made significant progress in creating a national societal reporting system by introducing the Findicator service.<ref>{{cite book |last1=Bourgon|first1=Jocelyne|title=A New Synthesis of Public Administration: Serving in the 21st Century|year=2011|publisher=McGill-Queen's Press - MQUP|url=|isbn=978-1553393191|page=98}}</ref>

Findicator was developed and the indicators selected in cooperation with users and producers of statistical data, such as politicians and their assistants.<ref name="fsd28"/> The service was discontinued in 2022.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://stat.fi/uutinen/maintenance-of-the-findicator-service-will-be-discontinued|title=Maintenance of the Findicator service will be discontinued}}</ref>
